description: Golden wire vectors for the foundation contract surface. wire holds the exact bytes a consumer parses; canonical, digest and signature are the values both consumers must reproduce. The Ed25519 key is a fixture-only key derived from a public seed and authorizes nothing.
signing_key_seed: sha256("agora fixture signing key; non-production; contracts/fixtures/vectors.json")

vectors.reason: unknown state variant must not be acknowledged
signature made over the allow payload
anchor semantics must match across engines
JSON 1.0 is the integer 1 in both parsers and canonicalizes to 1
urn prefix is not the wire form of an identifier
sequence must be a decimal string
body needs at least one scalar
messages are immutable; no edit field exists
null is not absent and not boolean
